scenes.supernova_script:
Ramesh says: I struggled to catch my breath, doctor. The pain in my chest is constant now, and the medicine is not helping.
Dr. Arjun says: Wow! Your English is amazing. Did you go to some expensive coaching class in the city?
Ramesh says: No doctor, those classes cost too much. Besides, I only studied up to the 5th standard in my village.
Dr. Arjun says: Then how are you speaking English so confidently?
Ramesh says: It's all because of Supernova AI. I practice every day with Miss Nova, my personal AI teacher.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hook: Relatable scenario where an underdog speaks flawless English to an authority figure.
- Establishes the contrast between expensive classes and the app.
- Names English early and introduces Miss Nova and Supernova AI.
